table_title: SUSPENDED-SEDIMENT DISCHARGE, WATER YEAR OCTOBER 1971 TO SEPTEMBER 1972
site_name: NACIMIENTO RIVER BELOW SAPAQUE CREEK, NEAR BRYSON, CALIF.
location_text: Lat 35°47'19", long 121°05'34", in SW1/4NE1/4 sec.3, T.25 S., R.8 E., San Luis Obispo County, at gaging station just downstream from Sapaque Creek, 1.4 miles south of Bryson.
quantities_units: mean discharge (cfs); mean concentration (mg/L); sediment discharge (tons/day)
notes: Continued table: this page shows APRIL, MAY, JUNE only, so measurements on this page are 1972 (the whole table covers water year Oct 1971 to Sept 1972). Station number and name are printed in the heading on the sampled page itself (so station number / station name evidence is 'heading before table' on page 182); the LOCATION paragraph with coordinates, section-township-range and county is on scan page 180 (printed p. 164). Water type is a judgment call: suspended-sediment table (Water Quality) that also carries daily mean discharge (Stream Discharge). The particle-size table lower on the page is table 2.
